title: Case 050: Status of a Supplier Payment
initial_request: I’m an authorised signatory for Northmere Studio Ltd. Our supplier says it has not received the payment we authorised for a materials invoice. Please tell me what stage H&V’s records show for that payment.
overview: Mara Ellison, an authorised company signatory, asked H&V to check a specific supplier payment after the supplier reported that the funds had not arrived. H&V’s payment team checked its record and reported the payment stage as “sent” to Mara through the secure portal. This confirms H&V’s recorded stage only; it does not establish receipt by the supplier or resolve the supply dispute.

next_action.summary: I asked H&V’s payment team to check the recorded stage of the specific authorised payment.

outcome: H&V reported “sent” for the payment in its journal and communicated that status to the authorised signatory. Whether the supplier has received the funds and the commercial dispute remain open.

events.body: Payment authorisation recorded for the materials invoice from Alder Quay Supplies.
I’m the company signatory for this payment. Alder Quay Supplies says it has not received the funds; please check the stage shown in H&V’s records.
I’m escalating this specific payment under case HV-050. Please check and confirm the payment stage recorded in H&V’s journal.
I checked the payment journal. The recorded stage is “sent”; this record does not confirm receipt by the recipient’s bank or supplier.
Our payment journal shows this payment as “sent”. This is the stage recorded by H&V; we cannot confirm from that record whether the supplier has received the funds.
